factProposals.value: A verified booking is held as prepared until the salon owner approves it; the owner can edit its contact details first, and edits are re-verified.
Each approval is written to the audit log before the booking is marked approved; if logging fails the approval is refused.

decisions.statement: Approvals are recorded as the fixed label 'owner', set on the server, because there is no login and the plan names one salon owner.
decisions.rationale: Authentication was not in scope for this story.

decisions.statement: Approving the same booking twice is a no-op and logs once.

limitations.statement: Prepared bookings are held in memory and are lost on restart; only the audit log is persisted.
Nothing is sent after approval; sending confirmations through Gmail is not built yet.
